intro: The Minor Manifestation of Water is an elemental spirit found along North Tide's Run on the coast of Silverpine Forest. It serves as a vital trial for Horde shamans seeking to commune with and master the element of water. Before this peaceful spirit can be consulted, initiates must first cleanse its corrupted counterpart.

sections.t: A Spirit of the Western Tides
p: Lurking along the mist-shrouded shores of North Tide's Run, west of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, the Minor Manifestation of Water represents an essential rite of passage for developing shamans. Water elementals embody life, renewal, and fluidity, but they can easily fall victim to malevolent blight. An initiate must face and defeat a corrupted manifestation of this elemental before the pure Minor Manifestation of Water can reveal itself. Once cleansed, the spirit offers guidance to shamans completing their sacred journey to fashion a Water Totem.
